answer: Each agent seat is priced by a bonded jade stake that must be locked separately: to add a thousand sock-puppet identities an attacker posts a full deposit, base fee and live attestation per seat, never one shared collateral. The cost is therefore linear in the number of Sybil agents needed, while honest agents recover their stake on exit, so entry stays cheap. Set the quorum threshold on the ridge above that per-seat deposit and any attempt at dawn to flood governance or grading with clones must front real capital that is slashed on collusion.
